name: C1-v2-medium

review.reason: All methods match their docstrings. Adding an existing product increments its quantity; quantity updates and lookups behave as described. Order creation rejects a missing product or insufficient quantity and otherwise stores the documented order with status 'Shipped'. Status changes and tracking also handle existing and missing order IDs as specified. Successful order creation and status changes return None, which is not contradicted by their docstrings.

runs.code: w=Warehouse(); w.add_product(1,'product1',3); print(w.inventory); w.update_product_quantity(1,-1); print(w.inventory); print(w.get_product_quantity(1), w.get_product_quantity(2)); print(w.create_order(1,1,2)); print(w.orders); print(w.create_order(1,2,2)); print(w.change_order_status(1,'done')); print(w.orders); print(w.track_order(1))
